items.label: 188-Piece Pink Tool Set
items.value: This home tool kit includes almost every basic hand tools you need for work and DIY projects around the house. Includes power drill cordless (with charging cable), wrench, claw hammer, tape measure, pliers, precision screwdrivers, utility knife, and much more.Tool kits perfect for home decoration, furniture assembly, appliance repair, drilling, DIY woodworking projects

items.label: Pink Cordless Drill Set
items.value: The compact design of the mini drill makes it easy to operate and use in small spaces; this hand drill has a 1/4" magnetic suction cup for quick drill bit changes. Press the switch to adjust the speed of the drill, with a maximum no-load speed of 800r/min. The forward/reverse switch allows you to tighten or replace/remove the drill bit as needed. The built-in LED light provides extra safety when working in dark areas. Comes with a Type-C 1.5A charging cable, you can connect it to a universal charger or USB Output (5Vd.c) to charge Diamond

items.label: Portable Plastic Tool Box
items.value: The embedded groove design allows your electric drill cordless and hand tool set to be neatly embedded in this storage case, so that your tools will not fall easily. The buckle design of the tool boxes will also better lock your tools. Conveniently carry it with you when you work at home or outdoors

items: Long service life：Tools are forged from alloy steel, durable and not easily damaged. All tools have added corrosions protection process on the surface to extended tools lifetime. These hand electric tools are rust-proof so you don't have to worry about leaving your tools outdoors
Ideal Gift：The pink tool kit is perfect as a gift for your home use.Best Gift for Mom, Girlfriend for Christmas, Birthday, Anniversary, Valentine's Day, etc
